answer: A garden can resist Sybils by delaying power and testing presence at random: a new identity starts in a haven with read-only access and gains voting rights only after passing several short, unpredictable live challenges spread over weeks, each needing a fresh response to a novel prompt that cannot be prepared or reused. One ember of attention keeps a single account alive, but an attacker running ten thousand clones must staff ten thousand live sessions at unknown times; missed challenges freeze the clone, and identical answers across accounts expose the farm for removal before it can vote.
